content.thinking:
The legacy CLI can't find zstandard when run standalone (deps isn't in sys.path). Let me also add the sibling `../deps` to the path in the bootstrap of classify_responses.py (like campaign.py does). That makes the legacy CLI work standalone.

Let me update the bootstrap to also add `../deps`.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
old = """_HERE = _os.path.dirname(_os.path.abspath(__file__))
if _HERE not in _sys.path:                     # legacy CLIs run with -I
    _sys.path.insert(0, _HERE)
"""
new = """_HERE = _os.path.dirname(_os.path.abspath(__file__))
_DEPS = _os.path.join(_os.path.dirname(_HERE), 'deps')
for _entry in (_HERE, _DEPS):                  # legacy CLIs run with -I
    if _entry not in _sys.path:
        _sys.path.insert(0, _entry)
"""
for name in ('classify_responses.py', 'gen_targets.py'):
    p = pathlib.Path(name); s = p.read_text()
    assert old in s, name
    p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
PY
